title: OpenAEV scenarios channel pointer
description: The pointer of a release channel, published at a fixed place for each channel: the channel's release, by its name, and the SHA-256 of that release's manifest. A consumer reads it, then the manifest of the release it names, which must have that hash.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema the pointer follows.

repository.description: The repository the channel's releases come from.

channel.description: edge, where every release is published; stable, where a release recommended to everyone is promoted.

release.description: The name of the channel's release, MAJOR.YYMMDD.N: the manifest's schema_version, its date, a day the calendar has, and its rank that day, from 0. The releases published before were named YYYY.MM.DD.N, the rank from 1, and come before every name of that form. A channel moves to a later release, never back.

manifest_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of that release's manifest.json, as published.
